## PR Summary

<!-- CURSOR_SUMMARY -->
**Low Risk**
Small lifecycle fix in conversational AI client tooling with a targeted regression test; no auth or API surface changes.

**Overview**
Fixes **reused `ClientTools` instances** breaking synchronous client tools after a conversation ends. `stop()` shuts down the executor used for sync handlers, but `start()` did not replace it, so a second session raised `cannot schedule new futures after shutdown`.

**`ClientTools.start()`** now allocates a fresh **`ThreadPoolExecutor`** on each start (after the already-running guard), so every start/stop cycle has a working pool for `run_in_executor`.

Adds **`test_restart_runs_sync_tool`**, which runs a sync tool across two start → execute → stop cycles to lock in the behavior when sharing one `ClientTools` across multiple conversations.
